plan.explanation: The plan begins with face milling F1 on M3 to establish the datum. Subsequent drilling/reaming/tapping sequences for F2, F3, F5, and F8 follow their respective precedence chains (drill -> ream/tap). Slotting F4 is performed after the datum. Pocketing operations F6 and F7 are executed after the datum on compatible machines (M3 and M2 respectively). The sequence respects all machine capabilities and tool compatibility rules.
assumptions: Tool T6 and T7 are treated as interchangeable drills for spot drilling/drilling operations despite being listed separately in resources.
Machines M1, M2, M3, M4 can be reloaded with the same tool ID (T6/T7) without explicit setup steps defined.
uncertainties: Exact tool diameters for T6 and T7 are not specified; assuming they cover required hole sizes.
No collision checks performed between pocket operations F6/F7 and hole features F3, F5, F8.
